chunks: Abu Ali al-Ash'ari, from Muhammad ibn Abd al-Jabbar, from Ibn Abi Najran, from Abu Jamila, from Jabir, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said:

The Messenger of God (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'O group of reciters of the Quran! Fear God, Mighty and Majestic, regarding what He has entrusted you with from His Book, for indeed I will be questioned and you will be questioned. I will be questioned about the delivery of the Message, and as for you, you will be questioned about what you were entrusted with from the Book of God and my Sunnah.'

key_terms.تَبْلِيغ الرِّسَالَة: Delivery/conveyance of the Message — the prophetic mission of transmitting divine revelation
key_terms.حَمَّلَكُمْ: Entrusted you with/burdened you with — the root h-m-l conveys the weight of an amanah (trust)
key_terms.سُنَّتِي: My Sunnah — the Prophet's example and practice, alongside the Quran as a source of guidance
key_terms.قُرَّاء: Reciters/memorizers of the Quran — in early Islamic context, these were the scholarly transmitters and teachers of the Quran
key_terms.مَسْئُول: Accountable/questioned — one who will be held to account before God

ai.seo_question: What responsibility do Quran reciters have according to the Prophet Muhammad in Al-Kafi?
ai.summary: The Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family) addresses the Quran reciters — those who memorized and transmitted the Quran — reminding them that their privilege carries a weighty accountability. Just as the Prophet bears responsibility for conveying God's message to humanity, so too do the reciters bear responsibility for upholding, practicing, and teaching what they have been entrusted with from the Quran and Prophetic Sunnah. This hadith was transmitted through Imam al-Baqir (AS) and underscores that knowledge of scripture without corresponding action is a grave burden.
word_analysis: He has entrusted you with/burdened you with

en.hubeali:
Abu Ali Al Ashary, from Muhammad Bin Abdul Jabbar, from Ibn Abu Najran, from Abu Jameela, from Jabir, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘O group of reciters of the Quran! Fear Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic regarding what you are bearing from His<sup>azwj</sup> Book, for I<sup>saww</sup> would be Questioned and you all would be Questioned. I<sup>saww</sup> would be Questioned about the delivery of the Message, and as for you, so you would be Questioned about what you bore from the Book of Allah<sup>azwj</sup> and my<sup>saww</sup> Sunnah’’.
en.sarwar: 9. Abu Ali al-Ash’ari has narrated from Muhammad ibn ‘Abd al-Jabbar from ibn abu Najran from abu Jamilah from Jabir from abu Ja’far (a.s.) who has said the following:

“The Messenger of Allah has said, ‘O community of the readers of the Holy Quran be pious before Allah, the Most Majestic, the Most Holy, in the matters of the responsibility that He has placed upon you toward His book. I will be questioned and you will be questioned. I will be questioned about the preaching of the message and you will be questioned about your responsibility toward the book of Allah and my Sunnah (the laws).”’
